quotes.text: Treeherder failing with Exception: Missing fetch job for toolchain-win64-clang-18-raw: win64-cmake

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: When a toolchain port fails with a missing fetch job, inspect taskcluster reference-job registration before changing product source. Commit 273 adds win64-cmake because clang18raw fetch resolution could not find it. The upstream bug concerns linker/profiling exports, but the Thunderbird patch here only adds the missing fetch dependency. Keep diagnosis tied to the actual local failure. Source and bug context inspected; no CI run.
title: Toolchain bustage ports must register all fetched reference jobs
